description:

SAP PY Nordics Consultant
  
  
**Role:**  
Responsible for the development of the technical and functional vision that defines the project solution and able to translate this vision in directives, standards and procedures that guarantee a gradual implementation of the solution. He/she is responsible to ensure the technical and functional success of the implementation and/or project of improvement especially in complex projects and of great scale. They are known as a reference in the company and even in the market or between the competitors.

In addition to the tasks common to all STRADA employees, the specific tasks for this position are:
  
  
Adapt and prepare the technical environment advising on what products are the most appropriate depending on the requirements of the customer
  
Solve complex problems related to the technical environment of the application
  
Share and extrapolate his/her knowledge between different clients / work teams to optimize the service provided

Offers solutions that help the optimization and performance, improving the quality of the services
  
Disseminates knowledge as an expert explicitly or implicitly
  
To promote the adaptation of the system to changing business needs and technology
  
Advising on pre-sale actions
  
They are a technical reference and performs tasks of coaching and mentoring
  
They manage the pool of work optimizing the service provided
  
They provide suggestions that increase productivity and the quality of the service at a technical level Anticipates to problems at the project / support level and searches proactively alternative solutions
  
Ensures the profitability of the assigned tasks, performing a precise monitoring
  
  
**Required Skills:**  
In addition to the common skills for all STRADA employees, the specific requirements for this position are:
  
  
Availability to travel
  
Motivation and desire for improvement
  
Commitment to the customer and the company

Leadership skills

Capacity to make decisions
  
Ability to delegate and monitor
  
Capacity of anticipation to problems
  
**Time management:** compliance dates/deadlines
  
Overview of the application from the technical point of view
  
Capacity to identify risks and develop action plans to mitigate them
  
Ability to understand customer needs and identify new business opportunities
  
Capacity to collaborate on multiple projects simultaneously
  
Knowledge of structured analysis at an expert level
  
Knowledge of technical environment of development at an expert level
  
Knowledge of database design at an expert level
  
Knowledge of products of the market for information technology at an expert level
  
Knowledge of SAP architecture and platform euHReka at an expert level
  
Knowledge of Human Resources processes
  
Knowledge of various technical platforms
  
Knowledge of various programming languages at an expert level

Any Graduate

title: Lead Project Administrator
description:
As a Lead Project Administrator here at Honeywell, you will manage and direct the control and oversight of various aspects of a project, such as scheduling, cost management, risk assessment, and reporting.

In this role, you will impact the organization substantially by managing and overseeing the control, coordination, and oversight of various program and project management aspects. As a people leader at Honeywell, you will play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. As a key leader, you will continuously work to build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying and developing successors, driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture.

  

**Qualifications:**

* 7-12 years or more of work experience in design environment, with extensive on-site knowledge
* Knowledge of FAS, CCTV, Access Control System, BMS, Pharma qualification, Data center systems, and networking systems. Previous experience working with highly complex technical solutions.
* Proven track record in a project design and engineering capacity involved in the delivery of technology-based projects
* Previous exposure to a site base, construction environment.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Responsibilities:**

Core Activities

* Knowledge of Safety, Security and HVAC systems, Engineering design experience.
  + Study contract documents/tenders, mechanical plans and evaluate customer requirements and ability to do the Engineering reviews.
    - Building Automation System engineering, architecture and network design.
      * Project Documentation and handing over documentation preparation.
        + Experience and understanding of AutoCAD, BIM and Revit modeling.
          - Domain knowledge of Building Management System, Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control and MEP engineering systems and Data Center design experience. ( **preferred** ).
          - Excellent collaborative and organizational skills with the ability to communicate effectively with consultants and customers.
          - Assess customer site for design requirements, Complete complex and integrated system designs with technical requirements.
* Support Sales and Planning team for the pre-engineering activities to achieve on-time BOQ design and delivery, zero or positive deviation, proactive technical issue prevention and suggest cost effective design solutions to the customer.
* Support as necessary for trouble free design deliverables.
* Assist sales and P&E team by innovative use of technology in establishing system design and supporting to win the order.
* Prepare submittals per engineering standards, ensuring commitment dates are met. Review submittals with sales and delivery teams and lead team to obtain submittal approval.
* Drive common best practice system designs and engineered solutions. Issue of Design submittal in accordance with project planning requirements.
* Coordinates with Vendor/ Supplier representatives on design, commissioning & HO requirements.
* Co-ordinate with Design Department for submission and approval of Drawings from consultant / client
* Systems Known: FAS, CCTV, Access Control System, PAS, BMS, Smart Parking Management Systems, with their integration requirements for IBMS systems.

  

Systems & Platforms

FAS, CCTV, Access Control System, PAS, BMS, Chiller control system, Networking

  

Others

* AutoCAD and BIM Modelling ( **preferred** )
* MS Office
* MS Excel
* MS PowerPoint

  

People Management Responsibilities

* Drive Project performance to achieve:

* On time delivery

* Zero Deviation

* Proactive technical issue prevention

* Support as necessary for trouble free design deliverables.

  

Behaviors

* Be a Zealot for Growth
* Act with Urgency
* Be Courageous
* Be Committed
* Build exceptional talent

  

Span of Control

-

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Technical Presales Executive
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales conversion rate
* Revenue or sales target attainment
* Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Attach/upsell rate

* Interaction quality and compliance adherence

**Team/Stakeholder Interaction**

* Works closely with team leads, trainers, quality coaches, and operations teams
* Participates in regular coaching and performance reviews
* Supports customer insight sharing with internal stakeholders

**Any Domain-Specific or Project-Specific Requirements**

* High English proficiency required
* Familiarity with Microsoft products such as **Surface, Office, Xbox, and Windows/Azure/M365/Dynamics 365**
* Strong cultural awareness for the supported selling market

Ability to work in a structured, high-volume inbound sales environment

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Technical sales: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Managing Director – Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE)_PMO
description:
**Role Purpose**


The MD for the Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE) is accountable for establishing, scaling, and governing State Street’s high ‑ capability PMO function for client implementation across various workstreams in STT Alpha. The MD ensures that the iCoE becomes a **strategic capability** , reducing vendor dependency, improving cost efficiency, strengthening internal expertise, and enabling predictable client delivery at scale.  



**Key Responsibilities**


**iCoE Strategy, Design \& Build** ‑ **Out**


* Lead the end ‑ to ‑ end design and multi ‑ year implementation of the iCoE operating model, including functional scope, hiring strategy, location footprint, and resource mix.
  

Transition execution ‑ heavy work from high ‑ cost vendors into the iCoE through structured knowledge transfer, scaling internal capability, and reducing dependence on vendors
* A ligning contractor ‑ to ‑ FTE transitions and phasing resource migration strategically.
  

Drive FTE vs Contractor ratio strategy, establishing a sustainable talent supply model for PMO, and other iCoEs as required
**PMO** **CoE**

* The MD will oversee and build leadership capability across PMO functions – STT End to end implementation planning , Risk management, Reporting , Tools \& Automation / Ai initiatives
* Strengthen the focus on executing the PMO iCoE strategy, including contractor reduction, capability build\-out, location strategy and cost optimization
* A ccountable for the global strategy, delivery excellence, operating model, and financial performance of enterprise PMO services supporting large ‑ scale client implementations and platform transformations.
* Champion **AI** ‑ **enabled** **Program governance** **, intelligent** **data driven** **analytics, and** **risk** **management** capabilities
* Establish Standard governance, cadence, reporting standards, milestone planning, and dependencies management.
* Drive collaboration and partnerships with other CoEs and Alpha implementation teams to deliver client implementation programs successfully
* Stand up a unified India ‑ based PMO function with SMEs, leads, and analyst teams.
* Establish integrated support model with Conversion , Business Integration / Target Operating Model (TOM) Alignment , Environment Management, Alpha Data Services, Governance \& Vendor Relations .
* Ensure consistent delivery across **front, middle, and back** ‑ **office** **End to end** **implementations** , complex data flows, and integrations.
* Enable OBM (Outcome ‑ Based Model) transition by linking partner payments to outcomes and making sure that sub\-outcomes are delivered in a timely manner with expected quality
**People Leadership \& Capability Development**


* Build and lead a **leadership team** (VP/AVP layers) across PMO teams .
* Establish senior leadership layers within iCoE
* Manage onboarding of new hires , training, knowledge transfer and creation of standard PMO playbooks, frameworks and best practices.
* Drive capability building across CoEs , ensuring consistent training and best ‑ practice adoption.
* Foster a culture of **accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence** .
* Accountable for building a sustainable operating model, workforce planning, succession planning and long\-term hub growth.
* Establish **career paths, competency frameworks, and succession plans** for testing professionals.
* Lead capability build ‑ out in **India and other strategic hubs** , including CoE scale ‑ up and leadership bench strength.
* **Engage globally** and drive PMO strategy
**Governance, Reporting \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Create and operate iCoE governance structures across program reporting (client implementations) , risk management, productivity metrics, and leadership oversight.
* Represent iCoE progress to senior leadership and participate in recurring strategic governance meetings.
* Provide **clear executive** ‑ **level reporting** on quality, risks, dependencies, and decision points.
* Ensure alignment with the broader GCI and Alpha three ‑ year strategy, including OBM rollout and partner consolidation.
**Operational Efficiency, Productivity \& Financial Management**


* Achieve targeted cost reductions by shifting work from high ‑ cost locations to the India hub.
  

Improve FTE ‑ to ‑ contractor and HCL ‑ to ‑ Hub ratios, driving labor arbitrage benefits and operational scalability.
* Responsible for process simplification, automation, digitalization and AI adoption to improve productivity and scalability.
* Drive automation, standardization, tool adoption, reporting quality, and process enhancement.
  

Track financials, onboarding flows, hiring dependencies, and realization of O utcome based milestone payments
* A ccountability for tracking and delivering business benefits/ outcomes, including contractor reduction, productivity improvements and cost savings.
* Engage with vendor partners to manage consultants and deliver quality results
* Support sales and pre ‑ sales activities through estimation models, proposals, and client solution shaping
**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 15 \+ years in large ‑ scale implementation, transformation, PMO leadership in client implementation programs (global model) , or delivery operations in financial services.
* Proven success managing global delivery hubs or Centers of Excellence at scale.
* Demonstrated experience transitioning vendor work in ‑ house and managing hybrid workforce models.
* Proven track record leading **global, complex, client** ‑ **facing transformation programmes** .
* Deep understanding of **financial services platforms** , data ‑ heavy architectures, and regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of **P\&L, operating models, and large global team**
**Leadership \& Execution**


* Exceptional ability to build and lead multi ‑ disciplinary teams across Testing, PMO, Conversion, Product, Data, and Ops.
* Strong stakeholder influence across MD/SVP levels in Operations, Technology, and Client organizations.
**Technical \& Functional Acumen**


* Solid understanding of Front office, middle office and Back office components, implementation workflows, PMO tools and data migration models.
**Governance \& Change Management**


* Deep knowledge of PMO governance, risk management, performance metrics, and delivery controls.
